title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation failures are often detected only after the robot has committed to contact. This is especially limiting in wrist-camera setups: close gripper--object views help observe contact, but a poor approach may already push, miss, slip, or disturb the object before conventional detectors react. We introduce \emph{ContactGuard}, a pre-contact execution monitor for chunked visuomotor policies. Given the policy's planned action chunk, ContactGuard predicts its short-horizon consequence in latent visual space and aborts if the predicted future latent indicates likely failure. Its latent world model is trained from unlabelled robot trajectories to predict compact multi-view visual embeddings under planned actions, avoiding pixel-level video prediction. translated_title: ContactGuard：基于动作条件潜在世界模型的接触前执行监控
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13438v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：接触丰富的操作失败通常仅在机器人已经与物体接触后才被检测到。这在腕部相机设置中尤其受限：近距离的夹爪-物体视图有助于观察接触，但在传统检测器反应之前，一个不良的接近动作可能已经推动、错过、滑落或扰动物体。我们引入了ContactGuard，一种用于分块视觉运动策略的接触前执行监控器。给定策略计划的动作块，ContactGuard在潜在视觉空间中预测其短期后果，并在预测的未来潜在状态指示可能失败时中止操作。其潜在世界模型从无标签的机器人轨迹中训练，以在计划动作下预测紧凑的多视图视觉嵌入，避免像素级视频预测。然后，从小规模标记的接触前片段集合中训练一个轻量级失败探针。在部署时，ContactGuard在即将发生的接触事件之前锚定预测，从而提前干预。
tldr: ContactGuard通过潜在世界模型预测动作块的短期后果，在接触发生前检测并中止潜在失败，显著提升腕部相机设置下接触丰富操作的可靠性。
en_tdlr: ContactGuard predicts short-horizon consequences of action chunks via a latent world model, detecting and aborting potential failures before contact, significantly improving reliability in contact-rich manipulation with wrist-camera setups.
